description: Discover and invoke Scrape Creators social data API endpoints.

auth.label: API Key
auth.description: API key sent with the x-api-key header. Create or view it in the Scrape Creators dashboard: https://app.scrapecreators.com.

actions.name: discover_endpoints
actions.description: Discover current Scrape Creators GET and POST endpoints from the official OpenAPI document.

query.description: Text to match against the category, title, description, or path.

category.description: An exact OpenAPI category tag to include.

offset.description: The zero-based offset into matching endpoints.

limit.description: The maximum number of endpoints to return.

inputSchema.description: Filters and pagination for discovering Scrape Creators endpoints.

catalogVersion.description: The SHA-256 digest of the current OpenAPI document.

method.description: The HTTP method accepted by this endpoint.

path.description: The absolute Scrape Creators API path.

category.description: The endpoint category from the first OpenAPI tag.

title.description: The endpoint summary from the OpenAPI document.

description.description: The endpoint description from the OpenAPI document.

documentationUrl.description: The official documentation URL for this endpoint.

requestSchema.description: The current query and JSON body request contract.

items.description: One endpoint discovered from the official OpenAPI document.

endpoints.description: The discovered endpoints in this page.

total.description: The total number of endpoints matching the filters.

anyOf.description: The next offset when more endpoints match.

nextOffset.description: The next offset when more endpoints match.

stale.description: Whether a recent cached catalog was used after a refresh failure.

outputSchema.description: A page of currently documented Scrape Creators endpoints.

actions.name: get_credit_balance
actions.description: Get the remaining credit balance for the current Scrape Creators API key.

inputSchema.description: The input for getting the current credit balance.

anyOf.description: The remaining API credit balance when returned.

balance.description: The remaining API credit balance when returned.

raw.description: The complete response returned by Scrape Creators.

outputSchema.description: The current Scrape Creators credit balance response.

actions.name: invoke_endpoint
actions.description: Invoke a currently documented Scrape Creators GET or POST endpoint at the fixed official API origin.

path.description: The exact absolute path returned by discover_endpoints.

query.description: Query values keyed by exact upstream parameter name.

body.description: The JSON body for a documented POST endpoint.

request.description: The query parameters and optional JSON body for the endpoint.

inputSchema.description: A controlled dynamic Scrape Creators API invocation.

method.description: The HTTP method used for the request.

path.description: The documented API path used for the request.

outputSchema.description: The successful Scrape Creators endpoint response.
